title: Cannot change Cloud Directory Google account
symptom: The original Google account used for Cloud Directory has expired, and when trying to switch to a personal account, after clearing settings and setting up a new account, AAPS still holds the OAuth token for the original account, resulting in a Google error: 'This service is not available for your account.'
cause: Some settings stored in memory were not cleared properly when using the Clear Settings function.
fix: After selecting the account, restart the phone once. The issue is being investigated and fixed; also noted that this has been redesigned in v4.
evidence_quote: At first glance, it looks like some settings stored in memory were not cleared properly. For now, after selecting the account, please restart your phone once.
